v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given no existing events, when the meeting duration is 30 minutes on a Monday, then the earliest suggested slot is 09:00.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given there is a scheduled event from 14:00 to 15:20 when a 60-min. meeting is requested then no suggested meeting with start time interval
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given scheduled event ends at 15:00 when 30-min. meeting requested then 15:30 is included as valid slot time
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given the selected day is Friday when a meeting is required later than 15:00 then the start time is excluded from the suggested meeting slots

v2_human_g2_goal: To suggest all valid meeting start times within defined working hours that can accommodate a meeting of a given duration without overlapping any existing events.
v2_human_g2_input:
to events
type: List [Dict [str, str]]
format: {"start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}
valid values: start < end, use 24-hour time format
to meeting_duration
type: int
v2_human_g2_output:
valid_slots
type: List [str]
to a list of meeting times in "HH:MM" 24-hour format
